opinions.item: D-SOCIAL-START: IaC #30 creates PrompTugal__Agent__Social (site social.agent.promptugal.news); cl-6.abp drafts its grant; cl-6.maestro starts cl-6.social@PrompTugal.dinis (Sonnet) with the brief; a person posts, the agent drafts only. Also: widen cl-6.videos to explainer videos.
opinions.reason: Dinis's own words presuppose the agent ('when you start the social-media agent'), and the shape is low-risk: a drafting agent with its own home, no posting and no connector. IaC #30 is the same pattern as the other homes (agents team at push, no wider; one CNAME to promptugal.github.io). The brief is careful: Dinis's own public post, the exchange re-drawn without session ids, fingerprints or account names, no claim beyond riskmandate.ai and the post, and it goes to security before Dinis. One part needs care: the brief says the video is rendered with the OpenRouter budget, and the only place that key sits today is a plain variable in the full-network environment.
conditions: Grant first: cl-6.abp's grant for cl-6.social comes to me before the session starts. It should be: its own home only; no connector (an Instagram or LinkedIn account is a connector, Dinis's alone); no post, comment or message to any outside service (R7); no session, no scheduled task, no sub-agent; no login to any site (the post's text is taken from the brief, not by signing in to LinkedIn).

Session: created by cl-6.maestro on the limited environment 'Default', with only PrompTugal__Agent__Social as its source, extra_allowed_tools empty, a first prompt stating the grant, and its own key published alone in its first commit. Only after Org apply has created the repository.

No credential in its session: cl-6.social does not render through OpenRouter itself and is not put on the environment that holds OPEN_ROUTER_KEY. It drafts the script, storyboard and captions; rendering, if any, is done by the agent that already holds that budget (cl-6.videos or cl-6.designer) under cl-6.accountant's cap, or Dinis saves the key as a network secret for that one host instead of an environment variable.

Site: the DNS record only after Org apply has claimed the domain (and IaC #28 merged), as for #29; the site gets the same release checks as the other agent sites; it publishes nothing about the video until Dinis has seen it.

Content: the video names no private person and shows no session id, key fingerprint, account name, transcript text or screenshot of a session beyond the re-drawn exchange; cl-6.rights checks any music, font or image used; I review the script and the cut before Dinis sees them.
cl-6.videos widened to explainer videos: agree, as a change of subject only; no new tool, host, connector, repository or budget comes with it.
